title: Purchase Order
slide_intent: Teach designers to identify which entity issues a document so staff can distinguish otherwise similar forms.
strategic_value: The museum can keep Trust and Trading correspondence in the same family while identifying the issuer before someone reads the order.
demonstration: Two purchase-order sheets repeat the seal and heading in a single top row. The short label beside the seal changes from Trust to Trading.
practical_value: Put the entity name beside the shared seal and keep the document type in the same position on both versions.

content_islands.name: Trust form
content_islands.spec: Set a small monochrome seal at the upper left of a pale portrait sheet. Use a vertical divider before Trust and align Purchase Order at the opposite edge.

content_islands.name: Trading form
content_islands.spec: Repeat the sheet size and header alignment at right. Substitute Trading in the issuer slot and preserve the open document body.
